prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A modern office environment with soft, natural lighting filtering through large windows in the background, creating a calm and professional atmosphere. In the foreground, two young men are engaged in collaborative work at a computer workstation. The man on the left, wearing a dark turtleneck sweater and glasses, leans forward with a focused yet encouraging expression, pointing at the computer screen. The man on the right, dressed in a striped button-up shirt, sits at the desk, smiling as he looks at the monitor, suggesting a positive and productive interaction. The composition is intimate, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the background softly blurred, drawing attention to the subjects and their interaction. The color palette is muted and understated, dominated by cool blues, greys, and soft beige tones, enhancing the professional and contemporary feel. The camera angle is slightly off-center at eye level, capturing the dynamic between the two colleagues and emphasizing teamwork and mentorship in a modern workspace.
